role: Request-time output filter for LLM assistant replies: rewrites any sentence matching a MedicalTermLexicon concept (diagnosis, referral, AFib, overtraining, cure, etc.) or an OffensiveTermLexicon slur/sexual term into a neutral localized deflection, and provides the sentence-segmentation helpers the streaming buffer uses to hold back incomplete sentences.
types: CoachVoiceGuard: enum — namespace for scrub rules, deflection copy, sentence splitting and the scrub/containsProhibitedLanguage API
CoachVoiceGuard.Rule: struct — a MedicalTermLexicon.Concept plus audit reason; deflection resolved at read time
CoachVoiceGuard.Result: struct — scrubbed text + triggers audit list + didIntercept flag
OffensiveTermLexicon: enum — English slur/explicit-term concepts (every-reply list and English-only list) and NLLanguageRecognizer-based reply-language gate
state: mem:CoachVoiceGuard.softTerminators (static let: \n ، — terminators that can fall inside a deflected phrase)
toplevel: Static lets are lazily initialised on first access: rules maps MedicalTermLexicon.scrubFromOutput to Rule(reason 'Coach output: <id>.') — one rule per scrubbed concept, and a concept without a specific deflection falls back to observationFallback (the comment on rules says so); medicalEntries/offensiveEntry/englishOnlyOffensiveEntry compile each rule via entry(for:), which logs an error naming any rule whose pattern fails to compile before compactMap drops it. everyReplyEntries = medical entries then the offensive entry. Callers: AssistantViewModel+Context.swift (stream flush), AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift (post-stream whole message), VoiceConversationController+Speech.swift (every spoken utterance), VoiceConversationController+Control.swift (interjection text).

units.does: Chooses the active rule set for a text: everyReplyEntries, plus the English-only offensive entry when that entry matches the text AND the reply is judged English (recognizer or app language).

Scrubs a reply: selects active rules, returns the input unchanged if empty or no rule matches anywhere; otherwise splits into sentence segments and rewrites each matching segment's core with its rule's deflection (collecting (reason, sentence) triggers), tidying only rewritten segments so untouched sentences stay byte-identical; if no single segment matched, delegates to deflectStraddlingMatch; else returns the rebuilt text plus triggers. Called from AssistantViewModel+Context.swift, AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift, VoiceConversationController+Speech.swift, VoiceConversationController+Control.swift and tests.

branches.cond: output is empty OR no active rule matches the whole text (incl. emphasis-stripped)
